sections.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid (Dwarf). +2 Constitution, −2 Charisma. Land speed 20 ft. retains its value in medium or heavy armor and with medium or heavy loads. Darkvision 60 ft. LA +0.
Strong Swimmers gives +2 racial on Swim checks and doubles the Constitution score used to calculate breath-holding time. Seacliff dwarves use normal Swim checks and breathe air.

Use the doubled score with the table’s drowning procedure. Stormwrack p. 44 cites DMG p. 304, which starts at 2 rounds per point of Constitution (4 × actual Constitution for this variant). Stormwrack p. 11 and the printed Player’s Handbook Swim rule start at 1 round per point (2 × actual Constitution for this variant).
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground. +2 racial on saves against poison and +2 racial on saves against spells and spell-like effects.
Stonecunning gives +2 Search for unusual stonework, a check within 10 ft., access to stonework trap searches, and a sense of depth underground.
Weapon Familiarity treats the dwarven waraxe and dwarven urgrosh as martial. The dwarf keeps +4 dodge AC against giants but loses the usual +1 racial attack bonus against orcs and goblinoids.
+2 Appraise and Craft for work related to stone or metal. Common and Dwarven are automatic. Bonus languages are Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Terran, and Undercommon. Favored class Fighter.

sections.title: Original NPC · Brott Saltbrace
lines: Motive. Free the harbor gate while the lower line is submerged.
Hook. Brott can reach the jammed line through the flooded passage.
Seacliff Dwarf harbor guard, Fighter 1 · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0). · Medium Humanoid (Dwarf)

sections.title: Original NPC · Vessa Mere
lines: Motive. Find the dry exit before the water reaches the next landing.
Hook. Vessa spotted a recent seam in the wall beside the passage door.
Seacliff Dwarf stone-passage scout, Rogue 1 · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0). · Medium Humanoid (Dwarf)
